en.headline: Black Kite stages three-day craft beer festival at PMQ from tonight
en.dek: FLOCKFEST runs in the Central courtyard through Sunday with eight Hong Kong and Japanese breweries, local food stalls and indie sets; admission is free.
body: Black Kite Brewery opens FLOCKFEST 2026 at the PMQ courtyard in Central this evening, a three-day gathering of craft beer, independent music and food that runs through Sunday afternoon.

The organiser said eight breweries from Hong Kong and Japan would pour more than 50 beers across 20 taps, including eight collaboration brews made for the event. The Hong Kong names listed are Black Kite, Yardley Brothers, hEROES Beer Co and Deadman Brewery; the Japanese guests are West Coast Brewing, Far Yeast Brewing, Black Tide Brewing and DD4D Brewing. Food stalls named by the organiser include Chin Teng and Sonny's Slice Shop. Live sets listed for the weekend include Biascut, Reggie the Leaf, Black Lodge Cabaret, Mr Koo and Risy.

Admission is free. Hours are 5pm to 10pm today, noon to 10pm on Saturday and noon to 5pm on Sunday at the ground plaza of PMQ, 35 Aberdeen Street. Drink and merchandise packages have been on sale in advance. The nearest MTR station is Sheung Wan, Exit A2.

zh.headline: 黑鴛今晚起在元創方辦三日精釀啤酒節
zh.dek: FLOCKFEST今晚至周日在中環PMQ地面廣場舉行，八間港日酒廠、本地小食及獨立音樂演出，免費入場。
body: 本土精釀酒廠黑鴛今晚起在中環元創方地面廣場舉辦FLOCKFEST 2026，一連三日結合手工啤酒、獨立音樂及本地小食，至周日下午結束。

主辦單位表示，活動匯聚八間香港及日本酒廠，設20個龍頭，供應逾50款啤酒，包括八款為活動釀製的聯乘酒。本港酒廠包括黑鴛、Yardley Brothers、hEROES Beer Co及Deadman Brewery；日本酒廠則有West Coast Brewing、Far Yeast Brewing、Black Tide Brewing及DD4D Brewing。現場小食包括Chin Teng及Sonny's Slice Shop。周末演出名單包括Biascut、Reggie the Leaf、Black Lodge Cabaret、Mr Koo及Risy。
活動免費入場。今日下午5時至晚上10時、周六中午12時至晚上10時、周日中午12時至下午5時，地點為中環鴨巴甸街35號PMQ元創方地面廣場。飲品及周邊商品套票較早前已公開發售。港鐵上環站A2出口步行可達。
